I don’t have the specific beverage in memory — I only know you visited the farmer’s market this morning. Which of these would you like me to tell Henry, or write your own?

Options:
1) “I tried a cold-pressed ginger-turmeric tonic — spicy and bright, it was amazing.”  
2) “I had a small-batch passionfruit kombucha — tangy and refreshing.”  
3) “I enjoyed an artisanal lavender lemonade — delicate and floral.”  
4) “I tried a craft cold-brew coffee infused with orange zest — surprisingly lovely.”  
5) “I sampled a handcrafted cardamom chai latte — warm and cozy.”  
6) Write my own: (reply with the exact line you want me to send)

Also tell me:

If you want, say “Send option 2 with subject X and sign-off Y” (or just confirm a default choice) and I’ll send the email to henry.smith@example.com.
